SELECT a.*, b.scene_type FROM risk_source_ledger a left join risk_source_bim_config b on a.id = b.business_id and b.scene_type = #{param.sceneType} where scene_type is null
and a.area_id like CONCAT('%',#{param.areaId},'%')
and a.type_code=#{param.typeCode}
and (a.`name` like CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%') or a.`serial_number` like CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%'))
